description:
Infopro Digital, the B2B group specializing in information and technology, is currently looking for a Software Engineer - Data & AI on a permanent contract to strengthen the team at its Infopro Digital Automotive in Romania.

Infopro Digital Automotive is the Automotive division of the International Group Infopro Digital, founded in 2001 in France. Today, the Group counts 4,000 employees in 20 countries with headquarters in Paris.

Infopro Digital Automotive is a leading global provider of data and software solutions for the Automotive Aftermarket industry and supports Automotive professional businesses to succeed in an increasingly complex and digital world. As an Automotive data and software expert, Infopro Digital Automotive provides technical information and digital solutions to create an ecosystem that improves the quality and performance of Automotive professionals. We deliver end-to-end solutions, thereby empowering businesses to increase revenue through the generation of new opportunities and sales. Our aim is to optimize operational speed and efficiency, thus providing enhanced insights to improve overall productivity and efficiency.

 

Join Infopro Digital and become a Key Player in our Team!

 

With exciting job opportunities worldwide, Infopro Digital Automotive opens a vast universe of professional challenges.

Joining our group means plunging into the heart of stimulating collaborations within multidisciplinary teams.


The challenge awaiting you

We are looking for a senior-level software developer / engineer who can take ownership of end-to-end data pipelines and services, from sourcing and ingestion to transformation, storage, and delivery.  
You will play a key role in building and evolving our automotive data platform, enabling internal teams and client-facing applications to efficiently access and leverage structured, high-quality data.  


The tasks awaiting you:

This is a senior backend role focused on building modern data solutions that combine data engineering, scalable systems, and AI capabilities. 

  • You will work on designing and developing end-to-end data pipelines, handling data from multiple sources (APIs, files, third-party systems) and transforming it into structured, high-quality datasets. These datasets are then used across internal tools and client-facing applications. 
  • A key part of the role is building APIs and microservices using Java and Spring Boot, enabling fast and reliable access to data within a cloud-based environment (Azure / AWS). 
  • You will also contribute to innovative AI-driven initiatives, preparing data for machine learning and working with technologies such as LLMs, NLP, and intelligent data processing tools to support features like smart search, data enrichment and automation. 

In short, you will help transform complex data into valuable, accessible, and AI-ready solutions, using modern technologies and contributing to the development of a cutting-edge data platform.

Main Responsibilities: 

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT data pipelines from multiple sources (APIs, files, third-party)  
  • Develop REST APIs & microservices (Java, Spring Boot)  
  • Process and structure large-scale datasets  
  • Work with cloud platforms (Azure / AWS)  
  • Support AI/ML use cases (data preparation, integration, smart data features) 

 

 About you:

  • Around 5+ years of experience in software development  
  • Good knowledge of Java & Spring Boot or similar languages and frameworks 
  • Experience with SQL, APIs and working with data pipelines  
  • Experience handling complex datasets 
  • Interest in working with AI / ML technologies 
  • Advanced level of English is a must.

It would be a plus if you have 

  • Experience with Python 
  • Exposure to data lakes or streaming 
  • Worked with AI tools (LLMs, NLP, etc.) 
  • Understanding of scalable / distributed systems 

 

Are you a passionate professional looking for new opportunities? Don't wait any longer and join the Infopro Digital Automotive community of professionals!

 

The benefits that await you:

  • A professional development environment.
  • Training provided by the experts at Infopro Digital Automotive.
  • arious bonuses, depending on performance.
  • Possibility to work in a hybrid program.
  • Medical care subscription.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible work hours because a good work-life balance is very important to us.
  • Additional days off.


Our foundations and values

At Infopro Digital, we are driven by core values such as entrepreneurial spirit, constant customer focus, promoting diversity, striving for significant impact, and a collaborative culture. By joining us, you become part of a dynamic community that embraces these values daily, shaping the future with passion and commitment.

Diversity is one of our core values. We are convinced that our teams, drawn from all backgrounds and with different backgrounds and experiences, are one of the key drivers of our success. The Group is committed to a policy of equal opportunities and inclusion, from recruitment to career development, and we strive to provide an equitable working environment to promote the well-being of our teams.

Who are we?

 

Infopro Digital is a B2B group specializing in information and technology. With a presence in 20 countries, the group has 4,000 employees of 79 nationalities.

Infopro Digital connects professional communities.

Our brands are leaders in the five key economic sectors: construction and public sector, automotive, industry, risk & insurance, and retail.

With our solutions, our customers make informed decisions, and companies develop their business and sustainability.
